annotations.title: Screen Multi-Chain Wallet AML & Sanctions Risk

description: Screen EVM and Solana wallet addresses for native asset balances, recent transaction velocity, tornado/mixer exposure, OFAC sanctions flags, and automated anti-money-laundering (AML) risk scores (0-100).

addresses.description: EVM (0x...) or Solana base58 wallet addresses to screen.

chains.description: Blockchain networks to inspect for the provided addresses.

maxTransactions.description: Maximum number of recent transactions to inspect per wallet address.

name: screen_wallet_aml_risk
